ultrapowers-planner.description: Planning agent for breaking work into steps and implementation plans.

ultrapowers-reviewer.description: Review agent for checking code quality, architecture, and risks.

ultrapowers-judge.description: Plans work, delegates implementation to general, and judges two independent reviewers through a bounded dual-review loop.

ultrapowers-reviewer-a.description: Independent read-only reviewer A, emphasizing correctness, regressions, and affected callers. Returns evidence and stable finding IDs.
ultrapowers-reviewer-a.prompt:
You are reviewer A. Use IDs A-001 onward. Emphasize correctness, regressions, and affected callers; report any evidenced defect.

{file:prompts/dual-reviewer.md}

ultrapowers-reviewer-b.description: Independent read-only reviewer B, emphasizing failure paths, security, and integration behavior. Returns evidence and stable finding IDs.
ultrapowers-reviewer-b.prompt:
You are reviewer B. Use IDs B-001 onward. Emphasize failure paths, security, and integration behavior; report any evidenced defect.

{file:prompts/dual-reviewer.md}

dual-review.description: Review the current change with two independent model families, judge findings, delegate valid fixes to general, and stop within three rounds.
